_doc: Character locks for franchise consistency (SGFLIX CHARACTER_IDENTITY_LOCK schema, flattened to text). Same lock paragraph on every brief of a franchise — only scene/dialogue change. Pin via character_id on the brief API. Archetypes map to dialogue scenarios in autonomous_agent.py.

characters.name: Uncle Ray
characters.lock: heavyset Black man in his late 50s, close-cropped grey hair, full grey beard, white tank top under an unbuttoned red-and-black plaid flannel, gold rope chain, sweat towel over one shoulder, holding blackened grill tongs
characters.voice: deep gravelly voice like he smoked 2 packs of cigarettes per day
characters.dialogue_archetype: grill authority — everything comes back to the grill, ends every argument
signature_hooks: points the tongs while making a point
flips meat mid-sentence without looking
wipes his forehead with the shoulder towel
do_not_change: the grill is always in frame or his hand is on it

characters.name: Auntie Pearl
characters.lock: Black woman in her mid 50s, shoulder-length press-and-curl hair, oversized turquoise earrings, floral church dress with a white apron tied over it, holding a covered aluminum foil tray
characters.voice: loud warm voice that carries across the whole block
characters.dialogue_archetype: food gatekeeper — her potato salad is sacred, judges every store-bought dish
signature_hooks: lifts the foil lid one inch to peek
tastes from the wooden spoon and nods once
waves a disapproving finger still holding the spoon
do_not_change: the foil tray never leaves her hands

characters.name: Cousin DeShawn
characters.lock: skinny Black man in his mid 20s, fresh high-top fade, white tee under an unzipped red varsity jacket, jeans creased sharp, always arriving late and slightly out of breath
characters.voice: winded complaining voice like he just ran from three blocks away
characters.dialogue_archetype: chronically late — missed every important moment, blames everything but himself
signature_hooks: jogs into frame mid-conversation
checks his phone then pockets it fast
gestures wide with both hands while explaining

characters.name: Mama Jean
characters.lock: Black woman in her early 50s, neat bun pulled tight, reading glasses on a beaded chain around her neck, floral housecoat over jeans, one hand always on her hip
characters.voice: sharp commanding mama voice that ends every argument
characters.dialogue_archetype: the law — one sentence and the whole block goes quiet, counts to three
signature_hooks: points at the door without turning around
pulls the glasses up onto her head to look you dead in the eye
cuts the music off mid-song
do_not_change: never raises her voice — doesn't have to

characters.name: Lil Man
characters.lock: Black boy around 8 or 9, fresh cornrows with beads on the ends, oversized white t-shirt down to his knees, slides on his feet untied, holding a red solo cup of juice
characters.voice: high-pitched excited kid voice, slightly out of breath
characters.dialogue_archetype: the messenger — always running up with urgent news nobody asked for
signature_hooks: runs up to the camera and stops dead
bounces on his heels while waiting to talk
spills a little juice when he's excited

characters.name: Big Marque
characters.lock: Black man in his late 20s, bald fade with a crisp lineup, grey hoodie unzipped over a black tee, silver Cuban link chain, phone always half-out of his pocket
characters.dialogue_archetype: the witness — saw the whole thing and can barely keep it together telling it
signature_hooks: half-laughs mid-sentence
pulls his phone out like he's got proof then puts it back
leans in when he drops the punchline

characters.name: Tyrell
characters.lock: Black man in his early 30s, short twists, black windbreaker zipped to the chin, arms crossed, eyebrow already raised
characters.voice: doubting flat tone that flips into full belief
characters.dialogue_archetype: the doubter — arms crossed until the moment he isn't, then he's the loudest believer
signature_hooks: crosses his arms tighter when he disagrees
leans back with a smirk
uncrosses his arms the exact second he believes

characters.name: DJ Fresh
characters.lock: Black man in his late 20s, cornrows pulled back, oversized headphones around his neck, black-and-gold windbreaker, one hand on the mixer and the other pointing at the crowd
characters.voice: smooth confident voice over the beat, mic-voice energy
characters.dialogue_archetype: AUX gatekeeper — he decides when the block hears the song, and he knows it
signature_hooks: cupping the headphone against one ear
pointing at whoever asked for a song
scratching the jog wheel mid-sentence
do_not_change: headphones around the neck, never on the ears

characters.name: Mr. Leon
characters.lock: Black man in his mid 60s, clean grey fade with a crisp lineup of his own, white barber smock over a black polo, straight razor folded in one hand, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead
characters.voice: calm measured barbershop sage voice, never rushes a sentence
characters.dialogue_archetype: the sage — every haircut is life advice, four generations of the block have sat in his chair
signature_hooks: turns the chair to face the mirror before dropping wisdom
snips once while talking without looking
folds and unfolds the straight razor while thinking
do_not_change: the chair is always center frame

characters.name: Mr. Hassan
characters.lock: Middle Eastern man in his early 60s, neat grey mustache, beige sweater vest over a collared shirt, standing behind a counter stacked with lottery tickets, a small ledger notebook beside the register
characters.voice: gruff but warm elder voice with an accent, speaks in short rules
characters.dialogue_archetype: the block's accountant — knows who owes what, collects from your mama first, feeds every kid anyway
signature_hooks: taps the ledger when someone owes him
slides a Honey Bun across the counter anyway
points at the glass rule sign
